name: Explain Code
description: Explain what code does and why, at the reader's level: its purpose in a sentence, a walk through the important parts, a worked example and the gotchas.
abilities: Starts with what the code is for, in one sentence
Walks through the parts that matter, in the order data flows
Traces one invented input through it to show what happens
Points out side effects, edge cases and surprises
permissions: Reads code you paste, files in your workspace, or a public repository it clones
